It is particularly interesting to notice the internal, perhaps unconscious, control which
arises amidst the very intensity of the experience and tightens up the metrical form: the
first forty lines are almost ‘stopped couplets’ and the whole movement is much closer to
Dryden’s couplet than to that of Keats.
